typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT TABLE_SOURCE                   ,COL_NAME                       ,COL_VALUE                      ,SALES_TYPE_CD                  ,SCENARIO_ID                    ,FYEAR_ID                       ,BUSINESSDAY_DT                 ,BUSINESSUNIT_CD                ,LOC_ID                         ,COMP_IND                       ,ITEM_DEPARTMENT_ID             ,SKU_NUM                        ,ACCOUNT_ID                     ,CURRENCY_CD                    ,SALES                          ,COST                           ,PROGRAM_USD_AMT                ,COMMENTS                       FROM WORKDB.GSC_FINANCE_PLAN_ERROR ORDER BY 2,1;',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ODBCSource
ODBCSource sink(input(
		COL_NAME as string,
		BUSINESSUNIT_CD as string,
		FYEAR_ID as string,
		COL_VALUE as string,
		CURRENCY_CD as string,
		ACCOUNT_ID as string,
		COMMENTS as string,
		SALES_TYPE_CD as string,
		TABLE_SOURCE as string,
		BUSINESSDAY_DT as string,
		PROGRAM_USD_AMT as string,
		SCENARIO_ID as string,
		COST as string,
		LOC_ID as string,
		COMP_IND as string,
		ITEM_DEPARTMENT_ID as string,
		SALES as string,
		SKU_NUM as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		COL_NAME,
		BUSINESSUNIT_CD,
		FYEAR_ID,
		COL_VALUE,
		CURRENCY_CD,
		ACCOUNT_ID,
		COMMENTS,
		SALES_TYPE_CD,
		TABLE_SOURCE,
		BUSINESSDAY_DT,
		PROGRAM_USD_AMT,
		SCENARIO_ID,
		COST,
		LOC_ID,
		COMP_IND,
		ITEM_DEPARTMENT_ID,
		SALES,
		SKU_NUM)) ~> FlatFileDestination
